title: HarmTrace: Anchor-Calibrated Decoupled Optimization for Fine-Grained Target Identification in Harmful Memes
abstract: arXiv:2608.16622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal harmful meme detection is typically formulated as image--text harmfulness classification. A model may correctly predict harmfulness while misidentifying the attacked target or its supporting evidence. We therefore extend harmful meme detection with fine-grained target identification, asking what type of target is attacked, who is targeted, and where the target appears in the meme. The model predicts harmfulness for every meme and, for harmful memes, outputs the target category, target entity, textual mention, and visual region. To support this task, we introduce Meme3W, which unifies multiple public harmful meme datasets and provides human-verified annotations for harmful instances. We further introduce Joint Record Accuracy (JRA), a strict record-level metric requiring the harmfulness label and all target-identification fields to be jointly correct. translated_title: HarmTrace：锚定校准解耦优化在有害模因细粒度目标识别中的应用
translated_abstract: 多模态有害模因检测通常被建模为图像-文本的危害性分类任务。一个模型可能正确预测危害性，却错误识别被攻击的目标或其支撑证据。因此，我们将有害模因检测扩展为细粒度目标识别，询问攻击的目标类型、被攻击的对象是谁，以及目标在模因中出现的位置。该模型对每个模因预测危害性，并对有害模因输出目标类别、目标实体、文本提及和视觉区域。为支持此任务，我们引入了Meme3W，它统一了多个公开的有害模因数据集，并为有害实例提供人工验证的标注。我们进一步引入了联合记录准确率（JRA），这是一种严格的记录级指标，要求危害性标签和所有目标识别字段联合正确。对代表性多模态大语言模型的实验揭示了一个显著的...
tldr: 本文提出HarmTrace框架，通过锚定校准的解耦优化，将有害模因检测扩展到细粒度目标识别，并引入Meme3W数据集和JRA指标，以精确识别攻击目标类型、实体及位置。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HarmTrace, which extends harmful meme detection to fine-grained target identification via anchor-calibrated decoupled optimization, along with the Meme3W dataset and JRA metric for precise target type, entity, and location recognition.
